admission.justification: One owner-scoped projection, composition and display jointly prevent an unreadable history from appearing as absence and prevent inferred judgments; composed conversion/outline/retirement assertions guard distinct boundaries.

applicability: Recorded meaning-effect display for invariant and family records addressed by a converted Git-tree reviewer comparison.
conditions: Only the reviewed owner’s after-tree history rows in its admitted attempt files are eligible; the baseline is an identity fallback only.
Invariant changed and deleted/retire rows and family changed rows supply authored labels, own judged revisions, attempts, row/history identities, reasons and open/closed facts.
Attempt order, never wording/revisions/dispositions/counts, determines the sequence; multiple steps are successive judgments, not one net effect.
A complete readable no-step history is none; unreadable/legacy sides, incomplete indexes and invalid relevant rows are unavailable, never none.
Old family rows missing both effect and own revision remain explicitly unrecorded; half-recorded rows fail.
Outline and subject answers use the same projection in existing response paths; returned continuation members retain their own steps, and the worklist shows the governing row only.

The reading block remains outside disclosures. Tree rows remain one line and their accessible names retain the eligible owner-recorded effect sequence; the ordinary visible reason shows that sequence with its location count, while Memory currentness shows currentness. All nine label explanations remain keyboard-operable.
A current subject/task response missing meaning_effects is a failure; a present empty field is valid.
exclusions: Writing or backfilling historical effects, revision numbers or history files.
A label inferred from record text, members, reason, dispositions or counts; any leaf-wide net effect.
Installed delivery acceptance, latency acceptance and writer/closeout certification.
